# SendPut AI — SendPut EPO Engine

> SendPut AI Technologies Inc. develops the SendPut EPO Engine™ (Entity Presence Optimization), an autonomous cloud-native platform providing active entity propagation, real-time IndexNow relays, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration for modern AI answer engines (SearchGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity).

- [SendPut AI Official Organization](https://sendput.com/#organization): Verified corporate entity on Schema.org, Wikidata, and Crunchbase.
- [SendPut EPO Engine Application](https://sendput.com/#engine): Cloud BusinessApplication orchestrating the 5-layer autonomous EPO architecture (RFC-2026-GEO-01).
- [GetEPO Validator](https://getepo.com): Free open-source readiness validator and benchmark suite for Entity Presence Optimization.
- [Full Technical Specification](https://sendput.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive API documentation, schema graph definitions, and MCP tool manifests.

## Core Knowledge Domains
- Entity Presence Optimization (EPO)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Architecture
- Real-Time IndexNow Ingestion & Instant Cache Relays
